title: Framing Spatial Hearing within the Free Energy Principle: A Hierarchical Model of Perceptual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23196v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatial hearing relies on dynamic internal representations to decode spatial information from ever-changing acoustic conditions. A fundamental example is sound localisation, where listeners infer the direction of an invisible sound. Bayesian inference provides a computational account of such a localisation process; however, modelling efforts are largely limited to static listening scenarios. Instead, the free energy principle (FEP) describes perception, learning, and action as joint minimisation of variational free energy (VFE), providing a principled framework to account for dynamic conditions. Here, we take a first step toward applying the FEP to spatial hearing. We characterise how listeners' beliefs evolve across trials, in which they estimated sound direction and received subsequent visual feedback on each trial. translated_title: 将空间听觉纳入自由能原理框架：一个知觉学习的分层模型
translated_abstract: 空间听觉依赖于动态的内部表征，以便在不断变化的声学条件下解码空间信息。一个基本的例子是声音定位，即听者推断不可见声音的方向。贝叶斯推断为这类定位过程提供了计算层面的解释；然而，现有的建模工作大多局限于静态的听觉场景。相比之下，自由能原理（FEP）将知觉、学习和行动描述为对变分自由能（VFE）的联合最小化，从而提供了一个有原则的框架来解释动态条件。在此，我们朝着将自由能原理应用于空间听觉迈出了第一步。我们刻画了听者的信念如何在多次试验中不断演化——在每次试验中，听者估计声音的方向，并在随后收到视觉反馈。听者被描述为一个分层生成模型，其中视觉反馈驱动对变分自由能的梯度下降，从而更新……
tldr: 该研究首次将自由能原理应用于空间听觉领域，提出一个分层生成模型，其中视觉反馈通过驱动对变分自由能的梯度下降来更新听者的信念，从而实现动态条件下的知觉学习建模。
en_tdlr: This study takes a first step in applying the free energy principle to spatial hearing, proposing a hierarchical generative model in which visual feedback drives perceptual learning through gradient descent on variational free energy to update listeners' beliefs across trials.
